question: Which of the following ratio is greatest?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Compare to 1/2 (or 50%): 34/77 and 39/89 are less than 1/2, so eliminate them directly.

The remaining fractions 46/75 and 36/69 (simplified to 12/23) are both greater than 1/2.

Cross multiply the remaining fractions: 46/75 and 12/23.

46 × 23 = 1058 and 75 × 12 = 900.

Since 1058 > 900, 46/75 is the greatest ratio.

**∴ The correct answer is 46 : 75.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Four ratios: 46 : 75, 34 : 77, 39 : 89, 36 : 69

**Method Used:**

Convert each ratio into a percentage by multiplying by 100 to easily compare them on a uniform scale.

 
 
• 
 
• 
 
 46 : 75
 34 : 77
 39 : 89
 36 : 69

 
 
 
 
 

 
 61.33%
 44.16%
 43.82%
 52.17%

 
 Visual Comparison of Ratios as Percentages

**Calculations:**

⇒ 1st ratio = (46 ÷ 75) × 100 = 61.33%

⇒ 2nd ratio = (34 ÷ 77) × 100 ≈ 44.16%

⇒ 3rd ratio = (39 ÷ 89) × 100 ≈ 43.82%

⇒ 4th ratio = (36 ÷ 69) × 100 ≈ 52.17%

⇒ Comparing all percentages: 61.33% > 52.17% > 44.16% > 43.82%

⇒ The greatest percentage is 61.33%, which corresponds to the first ratio.

**∴ The correct answer is 46 : 75.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Cross Multiplication Method

To compare two fractions a/b and c/d, compute the cross products a × d and b × c. If ad > bc, then a/b > c/d.

Percentage Method

Converting ratios into percentages (by multiplying the fraction by 100) provides a uniform scale to compare multiple values effortlessly.

Denominator Equalization

Another fundamental way to compare fractions or ratios is by calculating the LCM of their denominators and expressing each fraction with this common base.
